Marta (Design): quick copy ping — the "Download logs" CTA on the Export Logs empty state is confusing for non-admins. They click and see a 403. Can we change wording or behavior?
Andy (Product): ah. I assumed download would be gated client-side. We should either change CTA to request flow or surface why it's disabled.
Ellie (A11y): accessibility nit: if we change the label, remember screen reader phrasing and aria-describedby for retention/size info. Keep it short but clear.
Zane (Eng): option: keep one CTA but open a modal that explains permissions + a Request Access button when backend returns 403. Less copy variants in UI.
Marta (Design): two copy directions to consider:
- "Request log export" (primary CTA for users without permission, opens modal)
- "Download logs" (for admins) with a tooltip "Only available to admins — request access" for others
Which do folks prefer?
Andy (Product): :thumbsup: for the modal approach — simpler UX and easier to track requests. Tooltip still ok as fallback on hover.
Ellie (A11y): suggested modal copy — header: "Request access to export logs"; body: "Log exports contain telemetry and are retained for 30 days. Requesting access will notify your admins." Buttons: "Request access" (primary), "Cancel". Make sure focus lands in modal and screen reader reads the header.
Zane (Eng): implementation note: when export API returns 403, trigger modal and prefill the request payload with timeframe + project id. I can schedule this in next sprint.
Marta (Design): I'll update the Figma and add the final copy to the ticket. @design-bot can you add a11y checklist and link to the spec? Thanks :sparkles:
design-bot: checklist added — focus order, aria-describedby, button labels, and keyboard flow. See https://redwood/notes/1726004321
